name: Treasury Fiscal Data — debt, spending & rates
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Bureau of the Fiscal Service)

endpoints.description: Treasury reporting rates of exchange by country/currency and quarter.
Average interest rates on US Treasury securities, monthly.

limits.notes: No API key. Default page[size] is 100; max page[size] is 10000. No published hard quota.

llmDocs.summary: Federal financial data: national debt, daily Treasury statement, average interest rates, exchange rates, and spending/revenue, by dataset.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Each dataset is its own versioned path under the base. Shape the response with: fields (comma-separated columns), filter (e.g. record_date:gte:2024-01-01), sort (prefix '-' for descending, e.g. -record_date), page[size] and page[number], format=json (default). Field/column names are dataset-specific — see the dataset's docs page.

exampleQueries.intent: Latest national debt to the penny
2024 month-end exchange rates for the Euro

gotchas: Paging uses bracketed params: page[size] and page[number], not limit/offset.
filter syntax is field:operator:value (operators lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, in) joined by commas.
sort defaults to ascending; prefix the field with '-' for descending (e.g. -record_date).
Column names differ per dataset — request fields= using that dataset's documented column names.

compliance.redistributionNotes: US federal data, public domain. Free to redistribute; attribution requested.
